Trouble for Fauzi!

Chandra Kumar Bose, grandnephew of Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose, has objected to the teaser of Prabhas' period action film Fauzi. In a post on X on 26 October 2026, he said mixing fiction with history is a crime. He urged director Hanu Raghavapudi and the makers to pull the teaser down and release a new one that does not distort history. He also hoped Prabhas would read his appeal. The teaser, titled File No 25, was released on 23 October 2026 for Prabhas' 47th birthday. It shows Bose speaking to Adolf Hitler about Prabhas' fictional spy character. Some viewers say the scene turns Netaji into a side character, while Prabhas fans say Fauzi is a fictional story that uses historical figures.
